Private message · for Twin only

Dear Twin,

Happy birthday to the girl who somehow became one of the best parts of my life.

I love the little things about you — the way you look at me, the way you can make an ordinary moment feel like something I want to remember, and the way just seeing your name can change my mood.

If I had a Bat-Signal, I wouldn't use it to call Batman. I'd use it to find you. Every single time.

I hope this year gives you the kind of happiness you give me without even trying. I hope I get to be beside you for so many more birthdays, annoying you, loving you, and making memories with you.

Yours, always 🖤
Until September 29
